seoTitle: How to Set Up CyberPanel on a Hostinger VPS
metaDescription: A walkthrough for installing CyberPanel on Hostinger VPS in 2026, covering setup steps, dashboard access, and a look at current VPS pricing.
intro: CyberPanel is a popular, lightweight control panel, and pairing it with a Hostinger VPS gives you an affordable way to manage websites and servers with features like LiteSpeed and one-click WordPress installs. This guide walks through accessing your VPS, running the installation, and getting a sense of the pricing involved.

steps.heading: Access your Hostinger VPS dashboard
steps.body: Log into your Hostinger account and open the VPS management panel where you'll run the installation.

steps.heading: Run the CyberPanel installation
steps.body: Use the provided installation commands to install CyberPanel onto your VPS instance.

steps.heading: Log in to CyberPanel securely
steps.body: Once installed, log into the CyberPanel interface to start managing your websites and server settings.

steps.heading: Review VPS pricing plans
steps.body: Compare the latest Hostinger VPS pricing tiers to make sure the plan you're on matches your performance and budget needs.

faq.question: Is CyberPanel free to install on Hostinger VPS?
faq.answer: CyberPanel itself is a control panel you install on your VPS; you'll still pay for the underlying Hostinger VPS plan.

faq.question: Does CyberPanel support WordPress?
faq.answer: Yes, it includes one-click WordPress installation among its features, alongside SSL and LiteSpeed support.

faq.question: Is CyberPanel beginner-friendly?
faq.answer: It's designed to be accessible for beginners who still want fast performance and easier server management.

faq.question: What do I need before installing CyberPanel?
faq.answer: You'll need an active Hostinger VPS plan and access to its dashboard to run the installation commands.
